newsitem.title: USA: Glenayre okays 2.5 mln shr buyback.
newsitem.headline: Glenayre okays 2.5 mln shr buyback.

text.p: Glenayre Technologies Inc said on Wednesday that its board authorized the repurchase of up to 2.5 million shares of common stock, or about four percent of the company's shares outstanding.
The repurchases may occur in open market transactions from time to time at prices deemed appropriate by the executive committee of Glenayre, the company said.

The authorization follows completion of common stock purchases totaling approximately 1.5 million shares during the week preceding this announcement from a buyback plan approved in December 1994, Glenayre said.
Glenayre said repurchased shares will be acquired with corporate funds and will be held as treasury shares to be used for general corporate purposes.
The number of shares outstanding was not immediately available, but as of the end of its second quarter, the company had approximately 64 million shares outstanding.
